capturePolicy: Every state uses a fresh document and unchanged original component functions. Await original Lit children, both exact font weights, eight unchanged geometry/paint frames after each interaction, and at least three raw PNG frames with two consecutive equal images. Pointer-open menu states retain the pointer on their trigger. Menu hover/keyboard states open using keyboard focus plus Enter, then apply the named action. The identical explicit action protocol is used by candidate and reference; no synthetic state mutation or image transformation. Both complete38-state campaigns repeat byte-identically on each measured platform.
semantics: Original HA uses menuitem/focus transfer. The authored single picker uses combobox/listbox with focus on its trigger and aria-activedescendant; original painted focus states are compared separately. Original-token parity is not an accessible-palette claim.
